name: European B2B software – illustrative screening criteria (configurable example, not standard PE rules)
label: Illustrative and configurable screening criteria for a prototype. Not any firm's investment criteria and not an investment recommendation.

criteria.why: fits the illustrative equity cheque size
fragmented market leaves room for buy-and-build

screening_rule.conflicted_policy: A CONFLICTED criterion is never treated as passed. If every source value passes, it stays conflicted and goes to the conflict register; if any source value fails, it is an open question counted against the limit. The deal team records which basis to use.
screening_rule.text: Advance to diligence when no criterion is NOT MET and at most 2 criteria are UNKNOWN or CONFLICTED with a source value that fails; those become open diligence questions. Otherwise: not enough evidence to screen, or does not meet the criteria. A person on the deal team records the decision.
